features: Underfloor Heating Included in the Service Charge
Great Transport Links Inc Elizabeth Line
description_html:
A spacious one-bedroom apartment, west facing located on the first floor. Popular Type 27, with views over the playing field.
The apartment retains many original features, including the kitchen and bathroom. Full-height windows and a glass sliding door lead onto a balcony. Generous built-in wardrobe in the bedroom. A spacious bathroom with shower and separate W.C.
Mountjoy benefits from a beautiful entrance overlooking the lily ponds, church and the historic London Wall. Residents enjoy underfloor heating included within the service charge, lift access and use of the Barbican gardens.
The 24-hour car park attendants can hold keys and receive packages. Car parking and cycle storage are available by separate negotiation with the City of London.
Designed by the renowned architects Chamberlin, Powell & Bon, the Grade II-listed Barbican Estate is home to the Barbican Arts Centre, cinema, art gallery, concert hall, restaurants, bars and cafés. Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Tesco are all close by.
Perfectly located for the Elizabeth Line, with both Farringdon (offering direct services to Heathrow and Gatwick) and Liverpool Street stations within a short walk. Barbican, St Paul's and Moorgate Underground stations are also nearby, providing excellent transport links across London.
Please note that, under the terms of the head lease, pets are not permitted.
No onward chain.
Service Charge: Estimated 2026/27 £5,525 + £3,665 (including PPM) non-annually recurring items.
Extended Lease: To 2196.
